Static locked-off single-shot with fixed frame throughout filmed with constant framerate in real-time. The scene shows a realistic scientific demonstration. The scene only contains the described setup and actions. A row of colorful wooden blocks has been lined up on a wooden table next to a black platform. The wooden stick attached to the black platform rotates clockwise and hits the first block.
"""
PixelWorld-Text case_0036 generation.

Scene: six colored wooden cuboids lined up diagonally on a wooden table
beside a black platform. A wooden stick attached to a black hub on the
platform rotates clockwise (screen sense), strikes the purple (nearest)
block, and the row topples as a domino cascade.

Method (see METHOD.md for details):
  * numeric RGB analysis -> exact masks for 6 blocks + stick + hub;
  * a clean background plate is built by 2-D membrane inpainting of the
    erased object pixels (plus matched grain);
  * block sprites cut from the original are rotated about their
    left-bottom ground-contact pivot;
  * the wood stick + black neck are rendered analytically (3x
    supersampled segment shading) behind the block layer; the static
    hub disc is never touched;
  * frame 0 is the untouched first_frame.png.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
from scipy import ndimage
from scipy.ndimage import distance_transform_edt, uniform_filter
import artifact_io

ROOT = Path(__file__).parent
SS = 3  # stick supersampling

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- geometry
PIVOT = np.array([208.0, 57.0])
ANG0 = np.array([-0.925, 0.390])          # frame-0 stick unit dir (x,y)
STICK_L = 60.0
BLOCK_ORDER = ['Y', 'R', 'K', 'G', 'B', 'P']          # far -> near
PIVOTS = {'Y': (55, 92), 'R': (68, 95), 'K': (88, 95),
          'G': (107, 102), 'B': (125, 106), 'P': (137, 109)}
T0 = {'P': 4, 'B': 6, 'G': 8, 'K': 10, 'R': 12, 'Y': 14}
PHI_MAX = {'P': 78, 'B': 75, 'G': 70, 'K': 66, 'R': 62, 'Y': 58}
FALL_DUR = 5.2

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- load
frame0 = np.array(Image.open(ROOT / 'first_frame.png').convert('RGB'))
H, W, _ = frame0.shape
imf = frame0.astype(int)
r, g, b = imf[..., 0], imf[..., 1], imf[..., 2]
MX = imf.max(axis=2)
yy, xx = np.mgrid[0:H, 0:W]


def biggest(mask, minsz=25):
    lab, n = ndimage.label(mask)
    out = np.zeros_like(mask)
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        c = lab == i
        if c.sum() >= minsz:
            out |= c
    return out


# ------------------------------------------------------- block color cores
mY = (r > 160) & (g > 105) & (b < 95) & (r - b > 80)
mR = (((r > 95) & (g < 80) & (b < 70) & (r - g > 45)) |
      ((r > 60) & (r < 110) & (g < 55) & (b < 50) & (r > g + 25)))
mK = ((r > 150) & (g > 85) & (g < 150) & (b > 80) & (b < 140) &
      (r - g > 40) & (abs(g - b) < 38))
mG = (g > 40) & (g > r + 12) & (g > b + 12)
mB = (b > 80) & (b > r + 45)
mP = (r > 50) & (b > 55) & (g < r - 12) & (g < b - 15)
cores = {'Y': biggest(mY), 'R': biggest(mR), 'K': biggest(mK),
         'G': biggest(mG), 'B': biggest(mB), 'P': biggest(mP)}

# ground-front line across the block zone
gx0, gx1 = 45, 160
ground_y = np.zeros(W, float)
col_bottom = {}
for j in BLOCK_ORDER:
    ys, xs = np.where(cores[j])
    for x in range(xs.min(), xs.max() + 1):
        yycol = np.where(cores[j][:, x])[0]
        if len(yycol):
            col_bottom[x] = max(col_bottom.get(x, 0), yycol.max())
cols = np.array(sorted(col_bottom))
vals = np.array([col_bottom[x] for x in cols])
ground_y[:] = np.interp(np.arange(W), cols, ndimage.uniform_filter1d(vals, 5))

# assign very-dark rim pixels to nearest block core (distance <= 3)
union_core = np.zeros((H, W), bool)
for mk in cores.values():
    union_core |= mk
above_ground = yy <= ground_y[None, :] + 3
candidate = (ndimage.binary_dilation(union_core, iterations=2) &
            (MX < 100) & above_ground & (xx < 172) & ~union_core)
dists = {j: distance_transform_edt(~cores[j]) for j in BLOCK_ORDER}
dstack = np.stack([dists[j] for j in BLOCK_ORDER])
nearest = dstack.argmin(axis=0)
nearest_d = dstack.min(axis=0)
sprite_mask = {j: cores[j].copy() for j in BLOCK_ORDER}
rim = candidate & (nearest_d <= 3.0)
for k, j in enumerate(BLOCK_ORDER):
    sprite_mask[j] |= rim & (nearest == k)
    sprite_mask[j] = biggest(sprite_mask[j], minsz=20)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- stick mask
rel = np.dstack([xx - PIVOT[0], yy - PIVOT[1]])
along0 = rel[..., 0] * ANG0[0] + rel[..., 1] * ANG0[1]
perp0 = rel[..., 0] * (-ANG0[1]) + rel[..., 1] * ANG0[0]
hub = ((xx - PIVOT[0]) ** 2 + (yy - PIVOT[1]) ** 2) <= 8.5 ** 2
stick_band = (along0 >= 6) & (along0 <= STICK_L) & (np.abs(perp0) <= 4.6)
neck_wedge = (MX < 55) & (xx >= 186) & (xx <= 220) & (yy >= 49) & (yy <= 72) & \
             ~hub & (perp0 > 1) & (along0 > 2) & (along0 < 22)
neck_wedge = biggest(neck_wedge, minsz=8)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- erase/plate
gap_shadow = (ndimage.binary_dilation(union_core, iterations=4) & (MX < 95) &
              above_ground & (xx < 175))
erase_blocks = ndimage.binary_closing(
    union_core | rim | gap_shadow, iterations=2)
erase = erase_blocks | ((stick_band | neck_wedge) & ~union_core)

plate = frame0.copy().astype(float)
good = ~erase
# per-row linear initialisation across erased runs
for y in range(H):
    bx = np.where(erase[y])[0]
    if len(bx):
        gx = np.where(good[y])[0]
        for c in range(3):
            plate[y, bx, c] = np.interp(bx, gx, frame0[y, gx, c].astype(float))
# 2-D membrane smoothing of erased pixels from good neighbours
for _ in range(45):
    flt = uniform_filter(plate, size=(9, 9, 1), mode='nearest')
    plate[erase] = flt[erase]

# grain matched to local table/platform residuals
blur = uniform_filter(frame0.astype(float), size=(1, 5, 1), mode='nearest')
resid = frame0.astype(float) - blur
table_zone = (xx < 172)
sig_t = resid[table_zone & good & (yy > 44) & (yy < 130)].std()
sig_p = resid[~table_zone & good & (yy > 40) & (yy < 100)].std()
rng = np.random.default_rng(36036)
noise = rng.normal(0, 1.0, (H, W, 3))
noise = uniform_filter(noise, size=(1, 3, 1))
noise_t = rng.normal(0, 1.0, (H, W))
sig = np.where(table_zone, sig_t, sig_p)
plate += (erase & ~hub)[..., None] * noise * sig[..., None]
plate = np.clip(plate, 0, 255).astype(np.uint8)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- sprites
def cut_sprite(name):
    mk = sprite_mask[name]
    ys, xs = np.where(mk)
    x0, x1, y0, y1 = xs.min() - 2, xs.max() + 3, ys.min() - 2, ys.max() + 3
    crop = frame0[y0:y1, x0:x1].copy()
    a = mk[y0:y1, x0:x1].astype(np.uint8) * 255
    # darken ground-contact edge of the sprite (underside line)
    bottom = np.where(mk.any(axis=1))[0].max()
    rgba = np.dstack([crop, a])
    return rgba, (x0, y0), bottom


SPRITES = {j: cut_sprite(j) for j in BLOCK_ORDER}


def paste_sprite(canvas, name, phi_deg):
    rgba, (x0, y0), bottom = SPRITES[name]
    px, py = PIVOTS[name]
    if phi_deg < 0.05:
        layer = Image.fromarray(rgba, 'RGBA')
        ox, oy = x0, y0
    else:
        img = Image.fromarray(rgba, 'RGBA')
        rot = img.rotate(phi_deg, resample=Image.BILINEAR, expand=True)
        # original pivot in crop coords
        lpx, lpy = px - x0, py - y0
        w0, h0 = img.size
        # pivot maps to center of expanded canvas
        cx0, cy0 = (w0 - 1) / 2.0, (h0 - 1) / 2.0
        w1, h1 = rot.size
        cx1, cy1 = (w1 - 1) / 2.0, (h1 - 1) / 2.0
        ox = px - lpx + (cx0 - cx1)
        oy = py - lpy + (cy0 - cy1)
        layer = rot
        ox, oy = int(round(ox)), int(round(oy))
    base = Image.fromarray(canvas, 'RGB').convert('RGBA')
    base.alpha_composite(layer, (ox, oy))
    return np.array(base.convert('RGB'))


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- stick draw
def cw(theta_deg):
    """Rotate frame-0 direction clockwise (screen sense)."""
    t = np.deg2rad(theta_deg)
    c, s = np.cos(t), np.sin(t)
    return np.array([ANG0[0] * c - ANG0[1] * s,
                     ANG0[0] * s + ANG0[1] * c])


def stick_layer(theta_deg):
    u = cw(theta_deg)
    nrm = np.array([-u[1], u[0]])
    Hs, Ws = H * SS, W * SS
    P = PIVOT * SS
    us = u[SS] if False else u
    yyi, xxi = np.mgrid[0:Hs, 0:Ws]
    d = np.dstack([xxi - P[0], yyi - P[1]]).astype(float)
    along = d[..., 0] * u[0] + d[..., 1] * u[1]
    perp = d[..., 0] * nrm[0] + d[..., 1] * nrm[1]

    def band(r0, r1, hw):
        return (along >= r0 * SS) & (along <= r1 * SS) & (np.abs(perp) <= hw * SS)

    rgba = np.zeros((Hs, Ws, 4), np.float64)
    def paint(mask, color, alpha, soft=0.0):
        m = mask.astype(float)
        if soft:
            edge = np.clip((soft * SS - np.abs(np.abs(perp) - 0)) / (soft * SS), 0, 1)
            m *= np.maximum(np.clip((soft * SS - np.abs(np.abs(perp) -
                  (np.clip(np.abs(perp)/(hw_s*SS),0,1)*0)))/(soft*SS),0,1), 0)
        cover = m * alpha
        for k, v in enumerate(color):
            rgba[..., k] = cover * v + (1 - cover) * rgba[..., k]
        rgba[..., 3] = np.maximum(rgba[..., 3], cover * 255)

    # soft neck halo
    hw_s = 9.0
    m = band(6, 20, 9.0)
    cover = m * 0.5
    for k, v in enumerate((10, 8, 6)):
        rgba[..., k] = cover * v + (1 - cover) * rgba[..., k]
    rgba[..., 3] = np.maximum(rgba[..., 3], cover * 255)
    # black neck
    m = band(7, 18, 3.6)
    cover = m * 0.95
    for k, v in enumerate((14, 11, 8)):
        rgba[..., k] = cover * v + (1 - cover) * rgba[..., k]
    rgba[..., 3] = np.maximum(rgba[..., 3], cover * 255)
    # wood stick: shade body
    m = band(14, STICK_L, 3.4)
    cover = m * 0.97
    for k, v in enumerate((116, 84, 52)):
        rgba[..., k] = cover * v + (1 - cover) * rgba[..., k]
    rgba[..., 3] = np.maximum(rgba[..., 3], cover * 255)
    # bright core, offset toward lower-left (-normal) side
    mc = (along >= 15 * SS) & (along <= (STICK_L - 1) * SS) & \
         (perp >= -3.2 * SS) & (perp <= 1.6 * SS)
    cover = mc * 0.9
    for k, v in enumerate((184, 156, 122)):
        rgba[..., k] = cover * v + (1 - cover) * rgba[..., k]
    rgba[..., 3] = np.maximum(rgba[..., 3], cover * 255)
    # lit rim
    ml = (along >= 16 * SS) & (along <= (STICK_L - 2) * SS) & \
         (perp >= -3.0 * SS) & (perp <= -1.9 * SS)
    cover = ml * 0.8
    for k, v in enumerate((206, 184, 152)):
        rgba[..., k] = cover * v + (1 - cover) * rgba[..., k]
    rgba[..., 3] = np.maximum(rgba[..., 3], cover * 255)
    # rounded tip cap
    tip = P + u * STICK_L * SS
    mcap = ((xxi - tip[0]) ** 2 + (yyi - tip[1]) ** 2) <= (3.4 * SS) ** 2
    cover = mcap * 0.95
    for k, v in enumerate((120, 88, 55)):
        rgba[..., k] = cover * v + (1 - cover) * rgba[..., k]
    rgba[..., 3] = np.maximum(rgba[..., 3], cover * 255)
    mcap2 = ((xxi - tip[0]) ** 2 + (yyi - tip[1]) ** 2) <= (1.8 * SS) ** 2
    cover = mcap2 * 0.9
    for k, v in enumerate((184, 156, 122)):
        rgba[..., k] = cover * v + (1 - cover) * rgba[..., k]
    rgba[..., 3] = np.maximum(rgba[..., 3], cover * 255)

    small = Image.fromarray(np.clip(rgba, 0, 255).astype(np.uint8), 'RGBA')
    return small.resize((W, H), Image.LANCZOS)


def ground_shadow(canvas, phi_by_name):
    img = Image.fromarray(canvas, 'RGB').convert('RGBA')
    dr = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
    for j in BLOCK_ORDER:
        phi = np.deg2rad(phi_by_name[j])
        px, py = PIVOTS[j]
        ext = 13 * abs(np.sin(phi))
        rx = 8 + ext
        x0 = px - rx - ext * 0.9
        x1 = px + 5
        dy = 2.2
        if phi_by_name[j] < 1.5:
            continue
        dr.ellipse([x0, py - dy, x1, py + dy + 1], fill=(18, 13, 9, 60))
    return np.array(img.convert('RGB'))


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- timeline
def smooth(q):
    q = np.clip(q, 0, 1)
    return q * q * (3 - 2 * q)


def stick_angle(t):
    return 26.0 * np.clip(t / 13.0, 0, 1) ** 1.7


def lean(t, name):
    q = (t - T0[name]) / FALL_DUR
    return PHI_MAX[name] * smooth(q)


frames = [frame0]
for t in range(1, 20):
    canvas = plate.copy()
    phi = {j: lean(t, j) for j in BLOCK_ORDER}
    canvas = ground_shadow(canvas, phi)
    base = Image.fromarray(canvas, 'RGB').convert('RGBA')
    base.alpha_composite(stick_layer(stick_angle(t)))
    canvas = np.array(base.convert('RGB'))
    for j in BLOCK_ORDER:                       # far -> near
        canvas = paste_sprite(canvas, j, phi[j])
    frames.append(canvas)

frames = np.stack(frames).astype(np.uint8)
assert frames.shape == (20, 144, 256, 3)
assert np.array_equal(frames[0], frame0)
artifact_io.save(frames, ROOT)

# transition check sheet: selected frames + amplified predecessor diffs
sel = [0, 3, 6, 9, 12, 15, 18, 19]
sheet = Image.new('RGB', (4 * 256, 2 * (144 + 18)), (25, 28, 35))
dr = ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
for i, t in enumerate(sel):
    x, y = (i % 4) * 256, (i // 4) * (144 + 18)
    dr.text((x + 5, y + 3), f'frame {t+1}/20  {(t+1)/4:.2f}s', fill='white')
    sheet.paste(Image.fromarray(frames[t]), (x, y + 18))
    if t > 0:
        d = np.abs(frames[t].astype(int) - frames[t - 1].astype(int)).sum(2)
        heat = np.clip(d * 3, 0, 255).astype(np.uint8)
        diff = np.zeros_like(frames[t])
        diff[..., 0] = heat
        diff[..., 1] = (heat // 3)
        sheet.paste(Image.fromarray(diff), (x, y + 18 + (144 + 18)))
sheet.save(ROOT / 'transition_check.png')
print('done')

{

"""Output-only helpers. No drawing or generation policy is implemented here."""
from pathlib import Path
import base64
import json
import wave

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw


def save(frames, case_dir, audio=None):
    case_dir = Path(case_dir)
    frames = np.asarray(frames)
    path = case_dir / "task_spec.json"
    spec = json.loads(path.read_text()) if path.is_file() else {}
    n, h, w, fps = (spec.get("frames", 20), spec.get("height", 144), spec.get("width", 256), spec.get("fps", 4))
    assert frames.shape == (n, h, w, 3) and frames.dtype == np.uint8, frames.shape
    audio_spec = spec.get("audio")
    audio_url = None
    if audio_spec:
        samples = round(n / fps * audio_spec["sample_rate"])
        pcm = np.asarray(audio)
        if pcm.ndim == 1:
            pcm = pcm[:, None]
        assert pcm.shape == (samples, audio_spec["channels"]) and pcm.dtype == np.int16, (pcm.shape, pcm.dtype)
        with wave.open(str(case_dir / "audio.wav"), "wb") as handle:
            handle.setnchannels(audio_spec["channels"])
            handle.setsampwidth(2)
            handle.setframerate(audio_spec["sample_rate"])
            handle.writeframes(pcm.astype("<i2").tobytes())
        audio_url = "data:audio/wav;base64," + base64.b64encode((case_dir / "audio.wav").read_bytes()).decode()
    values = frames.astype(np.uint32)
    packed = (values[:, :, :, 0] << 16) | (values[:, :, :, 1] << 8) | values[:, :, :, 2]
    tensor = packed.transpose(1, 2, 0)
    np.savez_compressed(case_dir / "pixels.npz", pixels=tensor)

    folder = case_dir / "frames"
    folder.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    for index, frame in enumerate(frames):
        Image.fromarray(frame).save(folder / f"{index:02d}.png")

    sheet = Image.new("RGB", (w * 4, (h + 21) * 2), (25, 28, 35))
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
    for index, frame_index in enumerate(np.linspace(0, n - 1, 8).round().astype(int)):
        x, y = (index % 4) * w, (index // 4) * (h + 21)
        draw.text((x + 5, y + 3), f"frame {frame_index:02d} · {frame_index / fps:.2f}s", fill="white")
        sheet.paste(Image.fromarray(frames[frame_index]), (x, y + 21))
    sheet.save(case_dir / "inspection.png")

    transition = Image.new("RGB", (w * 4, h * 2 + 21), (25, 28, 35))
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(transition)
    for index, frame_index in enumerate(min(i, n-1) for i in range(4)):
        x = index * w
        draw.text((x + 5, 4), f"frame {frame_index:02d} · {frame_index / fps:.2f}s", fill="white")
        transition.paste(Image.fromarray(frames[frame_index]), (x, 21))
        transition.paste(Image.fromarray(frames[frame_index]).resize((w, h), Image.Resampling.NEAREST), (x, h + 21))
    transition.save(case_dir / "transition_check.png")

    encode = lambda array: base64.b64encode(np.asarray(array, dtype="<u4").tobytes()).decode()
    deltas = []
    for index in range(1, n):
        current = packed[index].reshape(-1)
        previous = packed[index - 1].reshape(-1)
        positions = np.flatnonzero(current != previous)
        packet = []
        if len(positions):
            bounds = np.r_[0, np.flatnonzero(np.diff(positions) > 1) + 1, len(positions)]
            for start, end in zip(bounds[:-1], bounds[1:]):
                offset = int(positions[start])
                count = int(end - start)
                packet.extend([offset, count])
                packet.extend(current[offset:offset + count].tolist())
        deltas.append(encode(packet))
    data = {
        "id": case_dir.name,
        "width": w, "height": h, "frames": n, "fps": fps, "audio": audio_url,
        "first": encode(packed[0].reshape(-1)),
        "deltas": deltas,
        "caption": (case_dir / "prompt.txt").read_text().strip(),
    }
    template = (Path(__file__).parent / "player_template.html").read_text()
    payload = json.dumps(data, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False).replace("<", "\\u003c")
    (case_dir / "index.html").write_text(template.replace("__ID__", case_dir.name).replace("__DATA__", payload))

"""Continue the supplied still using RGB operations and analytic cuboid geometry.

The rightmost block is purple in the source image. Face textures come only
from that image. Blocks tilt about their fixed lower left edges, contact
limits keep adjacent blocks from crossing, and the thin wooden arm turns
clockwise. No learned renderer, external references, or physics engine is used.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import json
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFilter
from scipy import ndimage
import cv2
import artifact_io

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
SS = 4
SOURCE = np.asarray(Image.open(ROOT / 'first_frame.png').convert('RGB'))
H, W = SOURCE.shape[:2]
ORDER = ['Y', 'R', 'K', 'G', 'B', 'P']
# Each block: front lower left point, front width, depth, upright height.
# The floor is seen obliquely, so its two projected axes are not orthogonal.
GEOMETRY = {
    'Y': ((56, 92), (7, 1), (8, -5), (-7, -40)),
    'R': ((72, 95), (8, 1), (8, -5), (-6, -40)),
    'K': ((89, 100), (9, 0), (7, -5), (-4, -42)),
    'G': ((108, 103), (9, 1), (7, -5), (-5, -43)),
    'B': ((126, 107), (8, 1), (6, -5), (-3, -44)),
    'P': ((139, 110), (10, 0), (6, -6), (-3, -44)),
}
GEOMETRY = {k: tuple(np.array(v, dtype=float) for v in vv)
            for k, vv in GEOMETRY.items()}
PIVOT = np.array([208., 57.])
DIRECTION = np.array([-56., 24.])
LENGTH = float(np.linalg.norm(DIRECTION))
DIRECTION /= LENGTH
START = dict(zip(ORDER, [12.2, 10.15, 8.1, 6.05, 4.0, 1.95]))
FALL_DURATION = 4.9


def polygon_mask(points):
    im = Image.new('L', (W * SS, H * SS))
    ImageDraw.Draw(im).polygon([tuple(p * SS) for p in points], fill=255)
    return np.asarray(im.resize((W, H), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)) / 255.


# Full object silhouettes retain the original face colors and soft edges.
MASKS = {}
for name, (p, vx, vd, vz) in GEOMETRY.items():
    outline = [p, p + vx, p + vx + vd, p + vx + vd + vz,
               p + vd + vz, p + vz]
    MASKS[name] = polygon_mask(outline)

# Color support fills small differences between the manually measured corners
# and the rounded wooden edges. It is confined to the block's own neighborhood.
r, g, b = SOURCE.astype(float).transpose(2, 0, 1)
color = {
    'Y': (r > 150) & (g > 100) & (b < 95) & (r - b > 80),
    'R': (r > g + 38) & (g < 85) & (b < 65),
    'K': (r > 135) & (g > 75) & (b > 75) & (r > g + 35),
    'G': (g > r + 10) & (g > b + 10),
    'B': (b > r + 40) & (b > 65),
    'P': (r > g + 12) & (b > g + 18) & (b > 50),
}
for name in ORDER:
    vicinity = ndimage.binary_dilation(MASKS[name] > .1, iterations=2)
    core = color[name] & vicinity
    MASKS[name] = np.maximum(MASKS[name], core.astype(float))

# Erase stationary silhouettes and their table shadows only where an object
# moves. The rest of the locked camera image is copied unchanged each frame.
ERASE = {}
for name, (p, vx, vd, vz) in GEOMETRY.items():
    mask = ndimage.binary_dilation(MASKS[name] > .05, iterations=2)
    yy, xx = np.mgrid[0:H, 0:W]
    ground = ((xx - (p[0] + 6)) / 14)**2 + ((yy - (p[1] + 1)) / 5.5)**2 < 1
    ERASE[name] = mask | ground


def arm_mask():
    yy, xx = np.mgrid[0:H, 0:W]
    dx, dy = xx - PIVOT[0], yy - PIVOT[1]
    along = dx * DIRECTION[0] + dy * DIRECTION[1]
    across = -dx * DIRECTION[1] + dy * DIRECTION[0]
    wood = (along >= 14) & (along < LENGTH + 1.5) & (abs(across) < 2.1)
    neck = (along > 4) & (along < 18) & (abs(across) < 4)
    return ndimage.binary_dilation(wood | neck, iterations=1)


ARM_ERASE = arm_mask()
ALL_ERASE = ARM_ERASE.copy()
for mask in ERASE.values():
    ALL_ERASE |= mask
PLATE = cv2.inpaint(SOURCE, ALL_ERASE.astype(np.uint8) * 255, 4, cv2.INPAINT_TELEA)
# A tiny fixed high-frequency table residual avoids entirely smooth exposed
# patches. The residual is sampled from the unobstructed table on the left.
blur = cv2.GaussianBlur(SOURCE.astype(float), (0, 0), 1.0)
residual = SOURCE.astype(float) - blur
yy, xx = np.mgrid[0:H, 0:W]
sx = np.clip(xx - 49, 0, W - 1)
sy = np.clip(yy + 29, 0, H - 1)
grain = residual[sy, sx]
wood_repair = ALL_ERASE & (xx < 172)
PLATE = np.clip(PLATE.astype(float) + wood_repair[..., None] * grain * .45,
                0, 255).astype(np.uint8)


def planar_rectangle(name, angle):
    """A mathematical contact cross section in the row/height plane."""
    p, vx, vd, vz = GEOMETRY[name]
    width, height = vx[0], -vz[1]
    a = np.deg2rad(angle)
    v = np.array([width * np.cos(a), width * np.sin(a)])
    z = np.array([-height * np.sin(a), height * np.cos(a)])
    base = np.array([p[0], 0.])
    return np.array([base, base + v, base + v + z, base + z])


def intersects(a, b):
    # Strict interior overlap of two convex rectangles, excluding contact.
    for points in (a, b):
        for edge in np.roll(points, -1, axis=0) - points:
            normal = np.array([-edge[1], edge[0]])
            ap, bp = a @ normal, b @ normal
            if ap.max() <= bp.min() + 1e-7 or bp.max() <= ap.min() + 1e-7:
                return False
    return True


def contact_limit(left, left_angle, right):
    obstacle = planar_rectangle(left, left_angle)
    # Find the first contact continuously from the upright pose.
    lo = 0.
    for hi in np.linspace(0., 90., 91)[1:]:
        if intersects(obstacle, planar_rectangle(right, hi)):
            for _ in range(20):
                mid = (lo + hi) / 2
                if intersects(obstacle, planar_rectangle(right, mid)):
                    hi = mid
                else:
                    lo = mid
            return max(0., lo - .025)
        lo = hi
    return 90.


REST = {'Y': 90.}
for left, right in zip(ORDER[:-1], ORDER[1:]):
    REST[right] = contact_limit(left, REST[left], right)


def smooth(q):
    q = np.clip(q, 0., 1.)
    return q * q * (3. - 2. * q)


def angles_at(t):
    # Staggered acceleration represents the right-to-left cascade. Contact
    # limits prevent a leading block from passing through its neighbor.
    result = {}
    for i, name in enumerate(ORDER):
        desired = REST[name] * smooth((t - START[name]) / FALL_DURATION)
        if i:
            left = ORDER[i - 1]
            desired = min(desired, contact_limit(left, result[left], name))
        result[name] = desired
    return result


# Directly rasterize a parallelogram, sampling only the corresponding face of
# the initial RGB image. The analytic transform exposes the correct surfaces
# and keeps the lower ground edge at its measured image coordinates.
def paint_face(canvas, point, axis1, axis2, src_point, src_axis1, src_axis2,
               light=1.):
    corners = np.array([point, point + axis1, point + axis1 + axis2, point + axis2])
    low = np.maximum(np.floor(corners.min(0) - 1).astype(int), 0)
    high = np.minimum(np.ceil(corners.max(0) + 1).astype(int), [W, H])
    x0, y0 = low
    x1, y1 = high
    if x1 <= x0 or y1 <= y0:
        return
    matrix = np.column_stack((axis1, axis2))
    if abs(np.linalg.det(matrix)) < .1:
        return
    gy, gx = np.mgrid[y0*SS:y1*SS, x0*SS:x1*SS]
    xy = np.stack(((gx + .5)/SS - point[0], (gy + .5)/SS - point[1]))
    uv = np.einsum('ij,jhw->ihw', np.linalg.inv(matrix), xy)
    u, v = uv
    coverage = (u >= 0) & (u <= 1) & (v >= 0) & (v <= 1)
    # Slightly inset texture coordinates exclude background antialias pixels.
    us, vs = np.clip(u, .055, .945), np.clip(v, .025, .975)
    src = src_point[:, None, None] + src_axis1[:, None, None]*us + src_axis2[:, None, None]*vs
    rgb = np.stack([ndimage.map_coordinates(SOURCE[..., c].astype(float),
                     [src[1], src[0]], order=1, mode='nearest') for c in range(3)], -1)
    rgb *= light
    alpha = coverage.astype(float)
    # Area reduction provides stable subpixel edges at the target resolution.
    sh = (y1-y0, SS, x1-x0, SS)
    alpha_small = alpha.reshape(sh).mean((1, 3))
    premul = (rgb * alpha[..., None]).reshape(*sh, 3).mean((1, 3))
    region = canvas[y0:y1, x0:x1]
    region[:] = region * (1-alpha_small[..., None]) + premul


def draw_block(canvas, name, angle):
    p, vx, vd, vz = GEOMETRY[name]
    a = np.deg2rad(angle)
    width, height = vx[0], -vz[1]
    tilted_x = vx*np.cos(a) + vz*(width/height)*np.sin(a)
    tilted_z = vz*np.cos(a) - vx*(height/width)*np.sin(a)
    # Front face remains visible throughout the fall.
    paint_face(canvas, p, tilted_x, tilted_z, p, vx, vz,
               light=1. - .045*np.sin(a))
    # The upper end turns away, while the bottom end can become visible.
    determinant = np.linalg.det(np.column_stack((tilted_x, vd)))
    if determinant < 0:
        paint_face(canvas, p+tilted_z, tilted_x, vd, p+vz, vx, vd,
                   light=1. - .2*np.sin(a))
    elif determinant > 0:
        paint_face(canvas, p, tilted_x, vd, p+vz, vx, vd, light=.62)
    # The original right side becomes the upward facing long wooden surface.
    paint_face(canvas, p+tilted_x, vd, tilted_z, p+vx, vd, vz,
               light=1. + .40*np.sin(a))


def shadow_layer(angles):
    layer = Image.new('L', (W*SS, H*SS))
    dr = ImageDraw.Draw(layer)
    for name in ORDER:
        angle = angles[name]
        if angle < .05:
            continue
        p, vx, vd, vz = GEOMETRY[name]
        a = np.deg2rad(angle)
        tip = p - vx * ((-vz[1])/vx[0]) * np.sin(a)
        # Floor footprint, gently offset away from the diffuse overhead light.
        pts = [p+[0,2], p+vx+vd+[2,3], tip+vx+vd+[3,4], tip+[1,3]]
        opacity = int(48 + 18*np.sin(a))
        dr.polygon([tuple(q*SS) for q in pts], fill=opacity)
        dr.ellipse(tuple((p + [-5, -1])*SS) + tuple((p + [13, 4])*SS), fill=76)
    layer = layer.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(1.6*SS))
    return np.asarray(layer.resize((W,H), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS))/255.


def arm_angle(t):
    return 26. * smooth(t / 14.)


def draw_arm(canvas, angle):
    theta = np.deg2rad(angle)
    c, s = np.cos(theta), np.sin(theta)
    direction = np.array([DIRECTION[0]*c-DIRECTION[1]*s,
                          DIRECTION[0]*s+DIRECTION[1]*c])
    begin = PIVOT + direction*15.5
    end = PIVOT + direction*LENGTH
    layer = Image.new('RGBA', (W*SS,H*SS))
    dr = ImageDraw.Draw(layer)
    # Thin rounded black connector and the pale wood, matching the still.
    dr.line([tuple((PIVOT+direction*3)*SS), tuple(begin*SS)],
            fill=(20,19,18,255), width=round(3.0*SS))
    dr.line([tuple(begin*SS), tuple(end*SS)],
            fill=(130,108,76,255), width=round(2.0*SS))
    normal = np.array([-direction[1], direction[0]])
    dr.line([tuple((begin-normal*.25)*SS), tuple((end-normal*.25)*SS)],
            fill=(205,182,144,255), width=round(1.3*SS))
    dr.ellipse(tuple((end-.7)*SS) + tuple((end+.7)*SS), fill=(193,165,124,255))
    layer = layer.resize((W,H), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
    rgba = np.asarray(layer).astype(float)
    alpha = rgba[...,3:4]/255.
    canvas[:] = canvas*(1-alpha) + rgba[...,:3]*alpha
    # Keep the small stationary mounting hub from the initial image.
    yy, xx = np.mgrid[0:H, 0:W]
    hub = (xx-PIVOT[0])**2 + (yy-PIVOT[1])**2 < 4.2**2
    canvas[hub] = SOURCE[hub]


def render(t):
    if t == 0:
        return SOURCE.copy()
    angles = angles_at(t)
    erase = ARM_ERASE.copy()
    for name in ORDER:
        if angles[name] > .03:
            erase |= ERASE[name]
    canvas = SOURCE.astype(float).copy()
    canvas[erase] = PLATE[erase]
    shadow = shadow_layer(angles)
    canvas *= (1 - shadow[...,None]*.62)
    draw_arm(canvas, arm_angle(t))
    for name in ORDER:
        if angles[name] <= .03:
            alpha = MASKS[name][...,None]
            canvas[:] = canvas*(1-alpha) + SOURCE*alpha
        else:
            draw_block(canvas, name, angles[name])
    return np.clip(np.rint(canvas),0,255).astype(np.uint8)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    frames = np.stack([render(t) for t in range(20)])
    assert frames.shape == (20,144,256,3) and frames.dtype == np.uint8
    assert np.array_equal(frames[0], SOURCE)
    artifact_io.save(frames, ROOT)
    report = {'frames':20, 'size':[256,144], 'fps':4,
              'frame_00_exact':bool(np.array_equal(frames[0], SOURCE)),
              'rightmost_source_median_rgb':np.median(SOURCE[73:95,139:148],axis=(0,1)).tolist(),
              'rest_angles':REST,
              'timeline':[{name:round(a,3) for name,a in angles_at(t).items()} for t in range(20)]}
    (ROOT/'.tmp'/'generation_check.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2))
    print('Saved 20 RGB frames, pixels.npz, and index.html; frame 00 matches exactly.')
